svg.title: 09-rdp-connection-sequence
svg.text: Pure-Go client: certificate trust before any credential; NLA (CredSSP/NTLMv2) or TLS logon; standard RDP security refused
Selected = standard RDP security (no TLS) → refused
ErrStandardSecurity ends the connection before any credential is sent; this client never uses RC4
TLS handshake (1.2+; 1.0 only with Allow legacy TLS)
System CA or saved fingerprint → continue. Otherwise the dialog shows the SHA-256 fingerprint
(and the previous one if it changed); the handshake waits. Reject → the connection ends.
It binds TLS to the NTLM login; without it no credential is sent. errorCode → named error (wrong
ALT B • TLS logon (Allow legacy TLS on): the Client Info PDU carries the logon inside TLS; no NLA over TLS 1.0 in Go
cliprdr text both ways (Share clipboard text on)
Logged in: a password marked Save is stored only now
Dashed arrows: server responses / events to the SPA
